description: Spec 032: after a release run refresh the machine-owned index (`_Index.md`) of every category folder: one table of the notes pkpipe wrote there (resource and learning notes: date, note, category, source, result, notebook link), so the results are findable without a plugin. Code lists the folders of the enabled categories and calls the vault tool for each; the tool reads the notes of one folder, renders the table and writes the file only when its text changed. A folder the vault policy does not allow, or one without any pkpipe note, is skipped and never stops the run. No note text leaves the vault server.
